loss: Your sandbox {{sandbox}} lost its last usable pool path. It will stop. Its disk is retained until {{deadline}}; deletion still requires positive cleanup proof.
restore: Access to your sandbox {{sandbox}} was restored before deletion. You may start it again if its disk survives and current limits permit.
notice: Offline hosts enforce stop on reconnect or the effective local lease. Offline or dead storage may delay cleanup. No disk survival is promised after an uncertain destroy.
